Fine-tuning Spanish speech recognition with limited labeled data
Measure how full fine-tuning, LoRA, and speech augmentation change Spanish transcription accuracy and adaptation cost. Spanish is the target language; the low-resource condition is
The Spanish experiment series uses its own dataset and run artifacts. Superseded results from the earlier language choice are archived and never compared with Spanish. Live results
Dataset: Google FLEURS, Latin American Spanish configuration  , licensed CC-BY-4.0. Official train, validation, and test splits are retained. Audio becomes mono 16 kHz WAV; empty o
Model: multilingual  , fixed repository revision  , Apache-2.0. Keeping the family, size, and revision fixed makes the initial strategy comparison interpretable. Tiny fits the avai
E0 is the untouched pretrained baseline. E1 updates all model parameters. E2 freezes the base weights and trains rank-eight LoRA updates on query and value projections ( ,  ), alph
Every tuned run has a maximum five-epoch budget, batch size eight, one gradient accumulation step, seed 42, AdamW, weight decay 0.01, gradient clipping 1.0, 10% warmup, and linear
CUDA uses bfloat16 when supported, otherwise scaled float16, with gradient checkpointing. Successful and skipped updates are counted. Non-finite loss stops training. Unaugmented fe
Training-only speed perturbation samples 0.95â€“1.05; additive Gaussian noise samples 20â€“35 dB SNR. Clips near thirty seconds are not slowed past the model context limit, avoiding tr
All references and predictions share Unicode NFC, lowercase, Unicode punctuation removal, and whitespace normalization. Spanish accents and Ã± are preserved. Generation is fixed at
E1 versus E0 measures full adaptation. E2 versus E0 measures adapter adaptation. E3 versus E1 and E4 versus E2 measure augmentation under each strategy. E2 versus E1 and E4 versus
WER and CER are computed using JiWER. Absolute WER reduction is baseline minus tuned WER in percentage points. Relative reduction divides that difference by baseline WER; it is und
Cost includes training wall time, peak PyTorch GPU allocation, trainable weights, and warmed generation latency. Peak allocation is not total board memory. Baseline trainable param
Checkpoints are independently loadable full models or LoRA adapters with their processor files. The experiment series evaluates only validation data. The held-out test set requires
Each run retains  ,  ,  ,  ,  , and   as applicable. The website shows optimizer updates, training loss, validation curves, selected epochs, recognition errors, baseline difference
FLEURS is read speech; results do not establish conversational or dialect-wide Spanish performance.
Missing speaker IDs prevent an independent audit of speaker separation.
One seed and one model size support an initial controlled study, not a universal ranking.
Augmentation and LoRA can worsen accuracy; all measured outcomes must be reported.
Training-set playground clips are diagnostic and cannot support evaluation claims.
